paraphrase: The glory of Ekādaśī/Dvādaśī: through King Rukmāṅgada's enforcement of the Ekādaśī fast his subjects all went to Viṣṇu's world, so that Yama's realm stood empty; Yama went to Brahmā and lamented.
speaker: Vasiṣṭha (frame)
